# Private ruling and question ids already present in lib/ and docs/adr/.
# Read by the "no lib/ or docs/adr/ file gains a private ruling or question
# id" test in test/statifier_blocks/block_type_test.exs, which defines the id
# shapes. One line per file and id: the file, the first sixteen hex characters
# of the id's SHA-256 (never the id itself), and how many times the file
# carries it, tab-separated. A new id is refused, not added here; a line is
# lowered or deleted when an id leaves its file.
